:::{#def-power}
#### Power, base, and exponent

Let $a$ be a real number and $n$ a
[natural number](notation.qmd#def-natural-numbers).
The $n$th **power** of $a$ is the product of $n$ copies of $a$:

$$a^n \eqdef \underbrace{a \cd a \cd \cdots \cd a}_{n \text{ factors}}$$

In $a^n$, $a$ is the **base** and $n$ is the **exponent**.
The second power $a^2$ is the **square** of $a$.

:::
